segment_contamination_dimensions: Material-specific sibling segments: buyers searching for a single named material (FRP only, GRP only, PUF only, GI only, MS only, PVC only, Aluminium only, Wooden only) are served by dedicated sibling MCATs (FRP Cabin, GRP Cabin, PUF Cabin, GI Portable Cabin, MS Porta Cabin, PVC Portable Cabin, Aluminium Office Cabins, Wooden Cabins) — names and alt names must not reduce to a single-material identity that would collide with those siblings.

Function-specific sibling segments: buyers searching exclusively for a security cabin, office cabin, prefabricated cabin, modular portable cabin, portable security cabin, prefabricated security cabin, or MS security cabin are served by dedicated siblings — names must not be reducible to those exact function+material combinations.

GRP Cabin (sibling ID 159318) is a direct name collision with 'GRP portable cabin' — the term 'GRP portable cabin' is retained in technical_synonyms as a descriptive synonym but is not used in any enhanced name variant.
